boundary: Professional practice coverage, not years of experience, human research, aesthetic quality or production readiness. Existing Flow stages, authority and gates remain canonical.

research.decision: Which problem, audience, journey and evidence justify building or changing this website?
exit_checks: Owner and scope agreed; missing decisions named
Facts separated from brief, inference and concept
Research tied to decisions; human validation UNKNOWN without sessions
Preservation and new-site content gaps explicit

fields: buyer, user, operator and approver (unknown or same person when justified)
budget, languages, devices, risk and exclusions
success metric with baseline/data source or UNKNOWN
routes, page roles, states and journeys
new project: available material and explicitly absent baseline

deliverables.output: research plan, evidence ledger and decision links
fields: question -> method -> evidence -> decision -> page/state -> verification
dated desk sources, limitations and counterevidence
direct-user sessions only with actual participation and consent
references chosen for audience and decision, not popularity
transfer mechanism and differences from this project
no copied brand assets, distinctive copy or complete composition
sitemap and role of each page
content entities, owners, proof and claim provenance

design.decision: Which composition and interaction serves each page job, and how will it be tested?
exit_checks: Materially different directions compared with real content
Contract checked; human approval applies to this version only

fields: distinct composition hypotheses, not palette swaps
real headings, proof objects, imagery and density
questions, capture-bound observations and chosen rationale
no human preference claim without actual observers
desktop, narrow mobile and intermediate transformations
long/empty/localized content, zoom and reading order
brand signatures without one hero repeated on every page
type, spacing, color roles, contrast and density
licensed imagery/icon direction and crop behavior
reduced motion, keyboard behavior and semantic names
task entry, action, result and recovery
validation, permission, offline/interruption states when relevant
goals, evidence links, page roles and compositions
source/capture hashes and current checker receipt

implementation.decision: How does the approved design become maintainable, truthful behavior without breaking the product?
exit_checks: Compiled spec and design are current
Critical paths work; real/mock behavior disclosed
Local checks and unresolved QA gaps recorded

fields: secrets, permissions, validation and privacy when relevant
SEO metadata and crawlability when applicable
deviations with rationale; no self-certified quality

qa.decision: What works on the rendered product, what remains uncertain, and what is safe to hand over?
exit_checks: Current captures cover declared route/viewport/state matrix
Visual, keyboard and journey observations recorded
Issues have severity and owner; approvals current
Handoff separates machine checks, human validation and release authorization

fields: hierarchy, typography, spacing, density, crop and content
comparison to current contract and baseline
captures, hashes, observations and severity; PNG alone does not prove good design
automated findings plus manual Tab order, traps and focus
labels, errors, names/roles, zoom/reflow, reduced motion
rendered focus smoke is not WCAG conformance
issue severity, owner and acceptance decision
machine, agent and human checks separated

deliverables.output: release/measurement plan or explicit future-phase boundary
fields: prototype: no production claim; next owner and verification plan
production candidate: approvals, deploy/rollback, security and monitoring
review cadence, real baseline and experiment decision rule

sources.use: Explore and define the problem before converging; iterate when evidence changes.
Research questions and methods follow decisions and learning needs.
Whole-service responsibility, accessible delivery and measured outcomes.
Scoped accessibility evaluation including human review.
Keyboard users need visible focus; static CSS is insufficient proof.
Separate field metrics from local lab observations.
Helpful content, crawlability and technical search requirements.
Risk-based security verification; a visual prototype does not prove security.
